necessary_context.content: Section 2.1 assumes an attained minimum. M_T comprises adaptive methods making T queries in S; the recorded output is the last queried point x_T. epsilon*_T(F,S;phi)=inf_{M in M_T} sup_{f in F} E_phi[f(x_T)-min_S f].
necessary_context.name: Optimization and output

necessary_context.content: O_{p,sigma}: joint noisy value and subgradient (fhat,zhat), E fhat=f(x), E zhat in partial f(x), E||zhat||_p^2<=sigma^2. No value-noise variance bound appears in Definition 1. Section 3 sets sigma=L.
necessary_context.name: Oracle

necessary_context.content: F_cv(S,L,p): convex real-valued f on convex S with |f(x)-f(y)|<=L||x-y||_q for every x,y in S, 1/p+1/q=1. S contains B_infinity(r), r>0.
necessary_context.name: Function class and geometry

necessary_context.content: rho(f,g)=inf_{x in S}[(f(x)-min f)+(g(x)-min g)]; psi=min_{alpha!=beta}rho(g_alpha,g_beta)>0. Lemmas 1-2 use the psi/3 unique decoder and Markov inequality: worst-case expected gap<=psi/9 implies maximal identification error<=1/3.
necessary_context.name: Testing reduction
